consumer: ticket #3 (frozen two-source input, five folds, consensus controls)

kept_observation_ids.definition: qc_status == 'pass' (QC only; pharmacology eligibility is ticket #1)

temp_env.rule: same physical plate and same vehicle; Media is a different arm and Blank is not a control

tahoe.rule: same plate and same cell line only; never average across the ~50 lines of a plate; the two control profiles of a group are two wells, not two donors

temp_env.note: 12 wells per plate before QC; ticketed counts per plate in the table

tahoe.note: 2 wells per (plate, cell line) group before QC; 700 groups

notes: lib_size_panel / n_genes_panel are computed here from the 22,537-probe raw plate matrices; lib_size_view / n_genes_detected_view are the frozen 18,164-gene view columns — different gene axes, never interchangeable
qc_reason is ';'-joined reason codes; the first element is the primary reason
qc_flags are informational and never change qc_status
raw_replicate is the source's own replicate field (temp_env); Tahoe has none — frozen_view_replicate_index is a generated index and must never be cited as biology

temp_env.meaning: a measured, non-zero gene: a zero in a well is a real zero

evidence.evidence: atlas gene_metadata maps the symbol FAM153B to ['ENSG00000289731']; ENSG00000182230 is absent, so the CM slot is an unmeasured gene, not a measured zero

tahoe.meaning: the CM axis slot is unmeasured in the atlas; it must be masked and never read as a measured zero

gene_measurement_mask.consumer_action: carry a boolean gene_measured vector for the 18,164 axis; FAM153B is False for Tahoe rows and True for temp_env rows

temp_env.vehicle_control_dmso: the only vehicle control; source of the consensus pool
temp_env.control_media: Media is NOT a vehicle control — never merge it into a DMSO pool
temp_env.positive_control_et1: ET-1 at 0.01 uM is a peptide positive control, not a small-molecule treatment; excluded from the training arm

tahoe.no_structure: 2 drugs have no resolvable structure: dropped by the dose encoder, counted as an input-layer exclusion, not a QC failure

labels.response_label: unknown for every row (no evidence source)
labels.toxicity_label: unknown for every row (no per-well viability readout in this repo)
labels.rule: never infer toxicity or low response from transcriptomic magnitude; the study-level readouts exist upstream but are not deposited here, see README

not_covered_by_this_ticket: the consensus c* value itself (ticket #3 builds it from the eligible DMSO rows)
any dose-response or toxicity label (tickets #3/#9, must be pre-registered)
